messages:
maya: Noticing intermittent packet loss between GPU pods on different nodes in us-west-2 since ~03:00 UTC. Apps show grpc retries and p99 tokenization latency spikes. Anyone else seeing geneve/gso noise?
raj: Yep. I pulled /sys/class/net/genev*/statistics on the nodes hitting errors. tx_dropped jumps in bursts on gpu-node-14/15/17. Quick snippet: ```bash
$ for i in /sys/class/net/genev*/statistics/tx_dropped; do echo $i $(cat $i); done
/sys/class/net/genev0/statistics/tx_dropped 423
/sys/class/net/genev1/statistics/tx_dropped 0
```
tolga: Could be GSO/GRO handling for encapsulated packets on mlx5. We rolled a kernel tree and NIC FW last night, right? I saw mlx5 logs about ULP changes in dmesg on a couple nodes.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: kernel-upgrade-daemonset finished rolling to gpu-pool at 02:52 UTC (rev: kernel-6.1.12).
maya: I ran tcpdump on a victim node and saw clusters of retransmits and duplicated acks right after big checkpoint uploads between workers. Example: ```
12:03:12.123456 IP src=10.10.5.12.443 -> dst=10.10.7.34.5080: Flags [P.], seq 2345:3456, ack 9876, win 32768, length 1111
12:03:12.123789 IP src=10.10.7.34.5080 -> dst=10.10.5.12.443: Flags [R] ...
```
raj: Let's try a quick workaround: disable GRO/GSO on the geneve interfaces and set a slightly higher MTU for the tunnel to avoid fragmenting encapsulated frames. Commands to run for canary: ```bash
# on node
ip link set dev genev0 mtu 8988
ethtool -K genev0 gro off gso off tso off
```
Also check geneve stats: ```bash
cat /sys/class/net/genev0/flow/egress_ecn_drop 2>/dev/null || true
cat /sys/class/net/genev0/statistics/tx_errors
```
tolga: That matches previous offload regression patterns we've seen with certain mlx5 fw + kernel combos: large encapsulated frames get mis-queued and dropped when GSO is on. Turning off GSO/GRO trades CPU for correctness but should stop the drops. We should measure CPU impact on a couple canary workers first.
ops-oncall: I'll spin up a 3-node canary set and apply the ethtool changes via a short-lived DaemonSet. Monitoring p99 network latency, grpc retries, and node CPU. Rolling to canary in ~10m, will report. :thumbsup:
maya: One more quick check — check qdisc backlog and per-CPU XPS/RPS mappings: `cat /proc/net/softnet_stat` and `ethtool -S eth0 | grep tx_pending` to see queue depth behavior. I saw spikes in softnet drops on the same nodes.
raj: If canary looks good we can push a cluster-wide mitigation and open a CI test to repro with iperf + encapsulation to validate FW/kernel combos. Will also file INF-4593 with links to dmesg, ethtool -S dumps, and tcpdump captures.
tolga: Long term: coordinate with NIC vendor for FW, and add a preflight kernel+fw smoke that runs encapsulated traffic tests on gpu pools. For now, workaround seems safe.
ops-oncall: Canary applied. First 30m look: tx_dropped on genev0 stable, p99 latency down ~40% for affected services. Leaving on for 2h then decide roll.
maya: Thanks all — adding playbook steps and the quick DaemonSet snippet to INF-4593.
